{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Prometheus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Prometheus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Unbreaking]] II. It is crafted from a [[Divine Fragment]], three diamonds and four [[Estus Ash]], and is the cheapest craftable source of Unbreaking.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/unbreaking.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Prometheus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Prometheus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Unbreaking applies to any item with durability. The [[Prayer of Daedalus]] gives Unbreaking III, but costs a full [[Divine Favor]].

== Trivia ==
* Prometheus is the Titan who stole fire for humanity and was punished by the gods. The developer's video names the unbreaking book as a reason the player needs divine fragments.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If you want to make an unbreaking book, Bedrock Busters, Crystal Hearts, or netherite, you need that fragment.}}</ref>
